partner_result_applied.statement: An original-coordinate principal 3x3 block with sigma_min>=kappa gives ||p_Q||_infinity<15.008/kappa for arbitrary cap-one product sources, outside interactions and affine terms.

new_result.statement: If two input laws pushed through the same measurable map have output densities bounded by M and full signed input total variation/L1 distance Delta, then for 1<=r<infinity, ||p_mu-p_nu||_r <= (2M)^(1-1/r) Delta^(1/r). For product densities Delta<=sum_i||f_i-g_i||_1.
new_result.fisher_comparison: For A=[[0,1,0],[1,0,0],[0,0,1]] and cube approximation Delta_m->0, outputs converge in every finite Lr at the displayed rate, while the completed partner theorem forces projected Fisher information J_E>=3/(4 Delta_m) for Fisher-regular approximants with Delta_m<=1/8.

regularity_ledger.fixed_matrix_continuity: Source-pinned account02/B15 theorem gives individually bounded C0 density for every fixed rank>=3 product quadratic.
